name: DR Congo (east)
value: FRN took Bunyakiri 8 Nov; no major city falls
summary: FRN rebels took Bunyakiri and Bulambika in South Kivu on 8 Nov; army plans counter-offensive; no major city has fallen
state: The FRN rebel coalition captured Bulambika and Bunyakiri town in Kalehe, South Kivu, on 8 Nov after advancing through Kahuzi-Biega park, and the army announced a counter-offensive on 9–10 Nov (Critical Threats, 11 Nov). Hills around Minembwe changed hands on 9–10 Nov. The UN peacekeeping chief met rebel coalition leaders in Goma on 3 Nov (Africanews). No capture of Goma, Bukavu or Uvira and no direct interstate fighting was found as of 12 Nov.
for_you: UK travellers should check FCDO travel advice for the DRC. Exposure is mainly humanitarian, with displacement in the Kivus, and through cobalt, coltan and copper supply chains.
rubric_hit: Active fighting (Watch); no capture of a major city or direct interstate fighting (Alert line)

why: A long war over mineral-rich territory, drawing in Rwanda and threatening a wider Great Lakes conflict.
drivers: M23/AFC advances, Rwanda involvement, peace deals, mineral trade.
